release_metadata.title: BioTasks notebook pilot: bioframe motifs to peaks
release_metadata.description: A notebook-grounded computational biology task derived from a pinned bioframe tutorial, with source provenance and separate scientific/native validation evidence.
release_metadata.methodology: Convert the pinned notebook, select and save terminal results, execute and replay the reference offline, then use GLM-5.3 to author and validate the task. Software choice remains open subject to the public validated contract. All model roles use GLM-5.3; this is a single-notebook transfer experiment.
